description: OHLCV candles for one Kraken pair: open, high, low, close, volume and trade count per bucket, oldest first. Only the intervals the venue actually serves are offered. Costs $0.001 USDC per call. Byte-identical to GET /market/kraken-ohlc?pair=XBTUSD&interval=15&limit=20.

interval.description: candle width in minutes (360 is rejected by Kraken; 30 and 720 are unmeasured and therefore not offered) (default "15")

pair.description: Kraken pair as the venue spells it: XBTUSD, ETHUSD, SOLUSD [required]

name: market_kraken_ohlc
title: Kraken OHLC candles
